title: A prayer or charm for long life

verses.t: Ye are alive. I fain would live. I fain would live my complete term of life.
Ye live dependent. I fain would live dependent. I fain would live my complete term of life.
Ye remain alive. I fain would remain alive. I fain would live my complete term of life.
Ye are life-givers. I fain would live. I fain would live my complete term of life.
